state.title: naoqi_rest

part.text:
The robot reached the end of the corridor and is now crouched and resting about 0.44 m in front of the red wall. The last camera image shows only the red wall ahead.

The route had five main turns, plus a few small heading fixes along the way:
1. About 3.4 m straight ahead.
2. Left turn, then up a stretch where the robot kept drifting toward the right-hand wall. It stepped sideways to the left a few times to get clear.
3. Right turn into the next section, then left again at a dead end.
4. A zig-zag where I first spotted red in the distance.
5. A right turn, then left. The red wall was at the end of that last stretch.

The robot never fell or bumped into anything. The robot's built-in collision protection stopped it a few times when it got close to a wall, and I corrected course from there. The battery is at 99%.
